Tooltip_item_DistillSmall:
Empty still. Makes spirit and charcoal, and holds water. Isopropyl needs a Pot II, gasohol a Pot III.
NEXT: charge it - 1 bucket of fermented mash, 4 litres of water, or 4 tree branches for charcoal.
THEN: put the charged pot in any heat source and cook it for 6 hours. A full pot is 4 servings.
ALSO: decanting Pot I is one-way. Upgrade to a Pot II for the spirit recharge and isopropyl.
Tooltip_item_DistillMedium:
Empty still. Makes spirit, isopropyl and charcoal, and holds water. Gasohol needs a Pot III.
NEXT: charge it - 1 bucket of fermented mash, 6 litres of water, or 6 tree branches for charcoal.
THEN: put the charged pot in any heat source and cook it for 6 hours. A full pot is 6 servings.
ALSO: 3 buckets, 18 beer bottles or 6 jars of spirit charge a 2nd run, which cooks to isopropyl.
Tooltip_item_DistillLarge:
Empty still. Makes spirit, isopropyl, charcoal and gasohol, and holds water. The full still.
NEXT: charge it - 1 bucket of fermented mash, 8 litres of water, 8 tree branches, or 8 motor oil cans.
THEN: put the charged pot in any heat source and cook it for 6 hours. A full pot is 8 servings.
ALSO: 4 buckets, 24 beer bottles or 8 jars of spirit charge a 2nd run, which cooks to isopropyl.
Tooltip_item_MagazineDistill1: How to build and run a Distill Pot I. First step of the still.
Tooltip_item_MagazineDistill2: Turning grain and potatoes into fermented mash - the feedstock for every still.
Tooltip_item_MagazineDistill3: Isopropyl (medical alcohol) by second distillation. Needs a Pot II, and unlocks the upgrade from a Pot I.
Tooltip_item_MagazineDistill4: Gasohol vehicle fuel from spirit and motor oil. Needs a Pot III, and unlocks the upgrade from a Pot II.

Tooltip_item_DistillSmallAlc:
Distilled spirit, 4 servings. 1 serving = 1 litre. Pouring it out returns the empty still.
NEXT: draw ONE bucket (2 servings) and keep the rest, or decant all 4 servings into 2 buckets.
ALSO: 1 serving fills a jar or 3 beer bottles; a full pot fills 4 jars or 12 beer bottles in one craft.
Use MAX in the Crafting window to do several at once - the right-click menu has no MAX button.

Use MAX in the Crafting window to do several at once - the right-click menu has no MAX button.

Charcoal filter, built from 8 coal, metal pipes, bleach, oats, wire and a beer can.
NEXT: Upgrade Distill Pot I to II - needs the filter, duct tape and Metalworking 2.
ALSO: dismantling it returns the 8 coal and most of the parts.

ALSO: dismantling it returns the extinguisher, alarm clock, wire and electronic scrap.

Tooltip_item_WhiteLightningCharred:
Stage 1 of 3. Charred oak is steeping in the jar. Leave it somewhere out of the way for about 30 days and it becomes Green Whiskey.
Aging follows the sandbox Food Rot Speed setting, so 30 days can be 18 to 75. A powered fridge slows it to a crawl - keep it in a cupboard, not the cooler.
Tooltip_item_WhiskeyGreen:
Stage 2 of 3. The spirit has taken colour from the char. About 60 more days - 90 in all since charring - and it becomes Scarlet Oak Whiskey.
Aging follows the sandbox Food Rot Speed setting, so 90 days can be 53 to 225. A powered fridge slows it to a crawl - keep it in a cupboard, not the cooler.
Tooltip_item_WhiskeyScarletOak: Fully aged. Smooth, dark and strong - the finest thing this still will ever make. It never spoils and it will not change any further.
